C1197.title: Beijing Resident Hit by SMS Verification Code Bombing Attack
C1197.summary: China Court Network reported in September 2017 that a Beijing resident surnamed Zhang received more than one hundred verification-code messages from different websites within ten minutes without initiating any requests. Other users described similar incidents. The report found paid and free bombing tools available online that repeatedly triggered website verification interfaces, while mobile carriers said such harassment was difficult to block directly.

references.title: Using Software for Verification Code 'Bombing': Lawyer Says It Constitutes Infringement - China Court Website
